reply.summary: Ranval is a sightless zealot who tracks enemies by sound and touch, preaching a harsh creed to street crews. Ranval treats pain as proof of conviction and never retreats once the chanting starts.

feats.scene: Ranval lands a clubbing strike on a heckler purely by the sound of his breathing.
Ranval shrugs off a bottle smashed across the back of the skull and keeps preaching.

reply.summary: Telanlia is a hired thug who bends light into dazzling beams, working best when paired with a partner. Telanlia has humbled armed sentinels by blinding them with focused glare.

feats.scene: Telanlia fuses a beam with a partner's and scorches a whole loading dock.
Telanlia is hurled through a brick wall by a retaliating soldier and staggers up.

reply.summary: Eotisa is a mercenary who hides a cloaking device under a tailored jacket to stalk targets unseen. Eotisa keeps failing jobs because meddling bystanders always stumble into the plan.

feats.scene: Eotisa vanishes and delivers a blind shove that floors a startled courier.
Eotisa takes a heavy stool to the ribs and flickers back into view, wheezing.

reply.summary: Nusiu is a luckless drifter who bumbles through odd jobs alongside two equally hapless friends. Nusiu builds a clanking thinking machine whose advice is always misread into disaster.

feats.scene: Nusiu swings a shovel at a gangster and spins himself into a ditch.
Nusiu falls off a moving freight car and walks away with only scrapes.

reply.summary: Luval is a veteran peacekeeper wielding a will-powered band that molds solid light into barriers and bolts. Luval guards a distant sector and dies in service, passing the band to a young successor.

feats.scene: Luval hurls a wall of hard light that flattens three snarling beasts at once.
Luval raises a glowing shield that holds against a collapsing cliff face.

reply.summary: Anauser is an incubus who poses as a carnival owner and drains the vitality of caged performers. Anauser grows strong on despair and is weakened when the captives find hope.

feats.scene: Anauser rakes a cage door off its hinges and flings it across the tent.
Anauser absorbs a thrown barrel of burning oil and laughs through the flames.

reply.summary: Tonst is a radiant winged being born on this world, trained to hunt a famed heroine yet softened by love. Tonst can unfurl wings of glowing light, crackle bolts, and force others to relive their worst memories.

feats.scene: Tonst fires a crackling bolt that scorches a warehouse roof and sends a flier tumbling.
Tonst endures a hammering volley from a stronger foe before her wings flare back.

reply.summary: Setilva is a helmeted sprinter who serves a militant regime in a mirror reality. Setilva runs so fast her footsteps ring out like gunfire.

feats.scene: Setilva streaks across a plaza before the first echo of her boots returns.
Setilva sprints into a steel door and buckles it inward.
Setilva skids across gravel at full pace and rises unharmed.

reply.summary: Lustrn is a prison escapee who wears a loud costume and stolen gloves that release crushing pulses. Lustrn is more thief than ideologue and cares little for the symbols she borrowed.

feats.scene: Lustrn claps the gloves together and blasts a gaping hole in a vault wall.
Lustrn is cornered and clubbed by guards, going down with a groan.

reply.summary: Serlinte is a green-skinned mercenary sealed in a frost-making suit that hides a grotesque face. Serlinte is the quietest of his crew and nobody knows if he is human or something stranger.

feats.scene: Serlinte exhales a freezing gust that glazes an entire shopping concourse in ice.
Serlinte keeps standing after a heated projectile cracks his visor.

reply.summary: Corriall is a pale hulking brute who served a veteran assassin and later a speed-obsessed cult. Corriall is happiest behind a wheel or crushing something with bare fists.

feats.scene: Corriall rams a fist through a parked truck and lifts it overhead.
Corriall is hit by a speeding van and only shakes his head.

reply.summary: Liulla is a fair-haired bruiser of murky origin who stalks the swamps of a southern state. Liulla tears through brush and boats with equal ease.

feats.scene: Liulla uproots a cypress trunk and swings it at a rowboat.
Liulla takes a point-blank shotgun blast and keeps wading forward.

reply.summary: Ceoeru is a shadowy menace known mostly through rumor, always lurking at the edge of a team of misfit heroes. Ceoeru prefers ambush and bluster to open combat.

feats.scene: Ceoeru drops a crate from a rafter onto a pursuer.
Ceoeru tumbles down a stairwell and bolts out a side door.

reply.summary: Eocoror is a bald, rocky-skinned sergeant who swore an oath and became the first recruit of a band of future champions. Eocoror drinks in energy, resists mental intrusion, and carries a flight band.

feats.scene: Eocoror hammers a fist into a landing pad and cracks the slab across.
Eocoror absorbs a point-blank energy discharge and stands unmarked.

reply.summary: Miaortel is a towering silicon-bodied soldier from a planet of living stone who was tricked into attacking his friends. Miaortel eventually learned the truth and became a loyal guardian of the team.

feats.scene: Miaortel pounds a cargo hauler flat with two clasped hands.
Miaortel stands in a collapsing silo as tons of grain bury him and walks out dusted.

reply.summary: Illlo is a pink-skinned, black-eyed peacekeeper who attended a solemn funeral of a fallen colleague. Illlo wields a will-driven band that conjures shields and bolts and carries him through the sky.

feats.scene: Illlo sculpts a glowing ram and smashes a derelict hull into scrap.
Illlo's shield of hard light shrugs off a meteor shower.

reply.summary: Resvor is a dark-eyed criminal whose nose can pick out a single trail across a whole district. Resvor helped a gang of oddly gifted crooks until his luck ran out.

feats.scene: Resvor tracks a courier by scent and tackles him in a closed alley.
Resvor takes a baton across the jaw and keeps sniffing the air.

reply.summary: Tinntete is a pale, eyeless demon who claims to be thousands of years old and revels in chaos for its own sake. Tinntete orchestrated a city-wide massacre purely for sport.

feats.scene: Tinntete flattens a delivery truck against a wall during a pitched battle.
Tinntete laughs through a street-wrecking brawl against a flying powerhouse.

reply.summary: Stieon is a living, thinking fluid sealed inside a mechanical shell, sent on assassinations by a shadowy order. Stieon cannot be killed by ordinary means, only frozen in place.

feats.scene: Stieon empties a pistol clip at two targets before they roll behind cover.
Stieon's shell is shredded and the liquid inside simply gathers itself back up.

reply.summary: Sircor is a red-haired raider who sails with a crew of sky pirates from a harsh world of warriors. Sircor boards ships with a cutlass in her teeth and an evil grin.

feats.scene: Sircor cleaves a cargo crate in half with one cutlass stroke.
Sircor tumbles across a hot deck plate and jumps back to her feet.

reply.summary: Satonan is a red-eyed warrior woman of a divine race who drinks life through her fangs and enslaves victims. Satonan can sense nearby presences and blast beams from her eyes.

feats.scene: Satonan bites through a champion's neck guard and drains him into a stupor.
Satonan is crushed beneath a toppled pillar and rises, rolling her shoulders.

reply.summary: Coriu is a brown-haired explosives expert who served on a secret wartime strike team. Coriu once helped storm a frozen fortress by blowing its gates apart.

feats.scene: Coriu packs charges around a stone gatehouse and levels it with one fuse.
Coriu dives behind a rock as shrapnel peppers the ground around him.

reply.summary: Valrni is a black-haired hired gun who took a contract on a flame-throwing vigilante and died on the job. Valrni relies on cheap pistols and cheaper bravado.

feats.scene: Valrni empties a pistol into a parked car's window.
Valrni is thrown against a lamp post and gets up cursing.

reply.summary: Llamau is a brown-haired outlaw archer who favors barbed shafts and bomb-tipped arrows. Llamau is loyal to his crooked circle and quick to suspect when a friend acts strangely.

feats.scene: Llamau looses a bomb-tipped arrow that blows a parked sedan apart.
Llamau ducks under a punch, then is flung into a crate and groans.

reply.summary: Resterolu is a cybernetically enhanced extortionist who bends the air around him to fly and to choke foes from afar. Resterolu leads raids on wealthy citizens until a stronger rival ends his streak.

feats.scene: Resterolu spins up a gale that tears the awning off a whole street of shops.
Resterolu is slammed through a billboard and rises with a metallic arm sparking.

reply.summary: Silsersto is a red-haired, winged minion bred in a lab to hunt teenage dial-wielders. Silsersto flies in swift loops and fires energy from her palms.

feats.scene: Silsersto fires twin palm beams that melt a lamppost.
Silsersto is clipped by a swinging pipe and spirals but catches herself in the air.

reply.summary: Siaseti is an indigo-skinned horned demon from the underworld, bound in a prison for rogue gifted beings. Siaseti joins a mass breakout and perishes in a massive blast.

feats.scene: Siaseti rips a cell door loose and flings it through a guard post.
Siaseti is caught in a vast detonation that finally ends him.

reply.summary: Sella is a sightless club musician who plays jazz in a bustling harbor city. Sella hears more in a single bar of music than most hear in a lifetime.

feats.scene: Sella swings a saxophone case and clips a mugger in the knee.
Sella tumbles off a stage step and plays on without a wince.

reply.summary: Rilcil is a winged storybook sprite who can breathe life into carved timber. Rilcil falls to a tyrant who harvests her energy to build wooden armies.

feats.scene: Rilcil touches a plank and it rises as a spear-wielding guard.
Rilcil is struck down by a heavy mallet and cannot rise.

reply.summary: Riase is a stage conjurer who slips into a ghostly flaming disguise to distract audiences while accomplices rob them. Riase relies on smoke, wires, and nerve.

feats.scene: Riase tips a burning brazier into the aisle and covers an escape.
Riase falls through a trapdoor and limps off backstage.

reply.summary: Lellote is a blue-haired sorceress with pale eyes who keeps reappearing after seeming deaths. Lellote schemes against a rival wizard, whom she fears more than any blade.

feats.scene: Lellote hurls a spiral of cold flame that collapses a temple roof.
Lellote is blasted into a lake and strolls out again, soaked and smiling.

reply.summary: Tiarn is a masked jouster who rides out to harass an archer hero with a long blue spear. Tiarn is little known beyond a single noisy appearance.

feats.scene: Tiarn lunges with a lance and pins a flag to a wall.
Tiarn is unhorsed in a ditch and clambers out dripping.

reply.summary: Tevarti is a killer-for-hire whose might waxes and wanes with the lunar cycle, peaking under a full orb. Tevarti flies, shrugs off bullets, and punches harder as night deepens.

feats.scene: Tevarti drives a full-moon punch through a bridge pier and drops the span.
Tevarti stands in a crumbling rooftop battle against a powerhouse and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Iumservos is a bald, wealthy lord who funds a hidden refuge and keeps a castle folded inside a small flat. Iumservos once courted and murdered brides and now spends his fortune on influence.

feats.scene: Iumservos swings a cane and cracks a rival's cheekbone.
Iumservos takes a thrown vase to the temple and keeps sneering.

reply.summary: Numseres is a green-eyed son of a card-themed crime dynasty with a tattoo of high cards. Numseres splits matter in a flash of crackling energy and bluffs through any standoff.

feats.scene: Numseres splits a steel locker door with a burst of fission energy.
Numseres is thrown into a vending machine and wheezes to his feet.

reply.summary: Tiuva is a spoiled college student who expects titles because of his uncle's donations. Tiuva drugs a champion athlete, ties her up, and meets a bullet-spoiling shot from a stranger.

feats.scene: Tiuva fires a handgun at a bound athlete and has the pistol shot from his hand.
Tiuva is tackled to a stone floor and cuffed, stunned.

reply.summary: Eolamco is a former wielder of a greed-fueled orange glow who hoards what he can grab. Eolamco keeps a distant, ill-defined stance toward both sides of any cosmic quarrel.

feats.scene: Eolamco shapes a glowing grabbing hand and snatches a freight pod out of the air.
Eolamco is knocked across a cavern and rises clutching his loot.

reply.summary: Tonror is a hybrid of two peoples, built by a scheming pair to ambush a divine champion. Tonror is a restless, hostile creature with little sense of belonging.

feats.scene: Tonror swings both arms and splinters a wooden door.
Tonror is flung over a counter and barely seems to notice.

reply.summary: Sonial is a black-haired hero of a border town who blinks from place to place in a heartbeat. Sonial is part of a close group of powered outcasts and has an eye for a certain scarab-armored teen.

feats.scene: Sonial blinks behind a thief and lands a kick to the spine.
Sonial crashes through a market stall and hops up laughing.

reply.summary: Liseoium is a blond foe of a singing heroine who can fly and turn unseen at will. Liseoium has a brother who tags along and shares her grudge.

feats.scene: Liseoium turns invisible and shoves a fighter off a fire escape.
Liseoium is clipped by a thrown trash can and skids to a stop in midair.

reply.summary: Teeoane is a black-haired young woman who took on a crackling energy form after a lab mishap. Teeoane turned bitter toward her mother and lashes out with electric fury.

feats.scene: Teeoane arcs lightning from both fists and blows out a transformer yard.
Teeoane scatters into pure charge and reforms after a heavy impact.

reply.summary: Vavelu is a teen tinkerer whose hands fused with machinery after a drone strike on his home. Vavelu commands any circuit with a gesture and defends his neighborhood.

feats.scene: Vavelu overloads a hovering drone's core and detonates it over an alley.
Vavelu is thrown from a rooftop and braces on his metal hands.

reply.summary: Ialentlan is a red-haired petty crook who reforms at midwinter after nearly dying for a lost bundle of cash. Ialentlan puts down a stolen pistol to give his young son a better example.

feats.scene: Ialentlan shoves a rival courier into a snowdrift.
Ialentlan is thrown across a kitchen table and gets up shaking.

reply.summary: Cervar is a brash marine who bickers endlessly with a navy shipmate yet saves his skin again and again. Cervar spends the war aboard a battleship moving from port to port.

feats.scene: Cervar throws a roundhouse and drops a sailor on a dockside.
Cervar takes a brawl across the mess hall and keeps grinning.

reply.summary: Eoiaiu is an amphibious sleeper agent with false memories who lives as a mild widower until a brain implant seizes control. Eoiaiu ends up building a bomb in his cellar and detonating himself.

feats.scene: Eoiaiu blows the foundation of his own house out in a single basement blast.
Eoiaiu endures a hard fall off a ladder and keeps working at his bench.

reply.summary: Sorirn is the most admired girl in her school, with white hair and violet eyes, who is quick with charm. Sorirn has a rocky on-and-off romance with a classmate.

feats.scene: Sorirn slaps a cafeteria tray out of a rival's hands.
Sorirn trips on a stair and catches the rail.

reply.summary: Eonrn is a selfish young woman who can will herself into a heroic, muscular double. Eonrn struggles for control with that second self, which seems to have won out.

feats.scene: Eonrn transforms and bends an iron gate off its posts.
Eonrn takes a truncheon blow in her stronger form and laughs.

reply.summary: Rnintial is a plush bear, button-eyed and brown, that sits at a make-believe tea gathering. Rnintial watches quietly as a bewitched hero is trapped in the game.

feats.scene: Rnintial tips over a tiny cup when a rabbit bumps the table.
Rnintial is squeezed hard by a child and springs back plump.

reply.summary: Aunto is a balding, orange-haired circus clown who impersonates a sea monarch when funds run short. Aunto gets partnered with his lookalike once the real heroes catch on.

feats.scene: Aunto hurls a cream pie across the ring and splats a ringmaster.
Aunto is shot out of a cannon and lands in a net, dizzy.

reply.summary: Esilu is a brown-furred, talking ape of towering intellect who is locked up for being unusual. Esilu is freed and consulted by advisors as the greatest thinker of his age.

feats.scene: Esilu swings from a dungeon chain and kicks a bolt loose.
Esilu endures a night on cold stone and wakes unbroken.
